title: Site Management Sync issue on NS
body:
Site is managed as an update of Therapy Event
- NS Sync works immediatly for the first event (without site location) but not later when site has been updated
- if Phone is offline during the site change, and then internet connection is enabled, then evenrything is correctly uploaded to NS

Will see if I can fix this issue with an event sent to NS plugin on location or note update of the TE to force NS upload...

comments.body:
When I add within submit() this line:
``` `te.ids = IDs()`  
it forces a new upload of the updated event (with location) in NS from my loop phone (with the same NS id).
I see on emulator the updated therapy event dowloaded in NSClient3 with location and arrow, but internal database of the emu is not updated.
